d: The Showroom Sales Executive is responsible for handling and facilitating customer enquiries and sales activities within the showroom and through digital channels. The position requires a customer-focused and commercially motivated individual who can sell products, prepare reports, monitor stock information, and follow company policies and procedures.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration/ Marketing or relevant
2 years of relevant experience in sales and communication role
Excellent Customer Service and Sales skills
Professional written and verbal communication skills to effectively promote Nass Commercial's portfolio
Basic understanding of digital marketing platforms
Excellent analytical abilities and attention to detail
r: li
Follow company sales policies, operational procedures, and approval limits
li
Handle both online and offline sales activities
li
Prepare sales and inventory reports using approved digital and AI tools
li
Maintain high standards of showroom appearance and product presentation
li
Prepare quotations, orders, invoices, and customer records accurately
li
Achieve assigned individual and showroom sales targets
li
Follow up on sales leads, open quotations, and pending customer decisions
li
Monitor product availability and report inventory shortages
li
Provide professional customer service before, during, and after the sale
li
Resolve routine customer complaints and escalate serious cases appropriately
li
Coordinate with internal departments to complete customer orders
li
Support team members and contribute to a positive sales environment
li
Develop the necessary skills to supervise the showroom and lead the team
li
Adhere to Nass Corporation standards and CIG in all marketing activities
li
To adhere to the requirements of Nass Commercial's integrated management system (IMS)
